services.value: Provides drinking and wastewater plant operation & monitoring by DEP certified licensed operators, including maintenance of site logs in compliance with DEP requirements. Also offers environmental water testing services including well water testing and sample collection/processing through its DOH certified commercial laboratory, plus water line clearance chlorination, sample collection, chain of custody documentation, and laboratory analysis (including bacteriological, CBOD, TSS, nitrate/nitrite, and well water tests).
